Bend one knee and cross that foot over the other leg.
Hug the knee and turn your chest towards it.
Look over your shoulder.
Hold and breathe slowly. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Slumping your back.
Forcing the turn with your arm.
tips: Sit taller on each breath in, turn a little more on each breath out.

voice.nameHowTo: Seated lower back stretch. Sit tall with your legs out. Bend one knee and cross that foot over the other leg. Hug the knee and turn your chest towards it, looking over your shoulder.

moves.name: Figure 4 Stretch
moves.intro: Lying on your back, you cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull. It stretches your glutes and hips.
howTo: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Thread your hands behind the bottom thigh.
Draw it towards you and hold.
Hold and breathe slowly. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Lifting your head off the floor.
Pulling the leg in hard.
tips: Push the crossed knee gently away to feel more stretch.

voice.nameHowTo: Figure four stretch. Lying face up, bend both knees and plant your feet. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then thread your hands behind the bottom thigh and draw it towards you. Hold and feel it in your hip.

moves.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
moves.intro: Kneeling on one knee, you shift forward. It stretches the front of your hip.
howTo: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front.
Tuck your hips under.
Shift forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold.
Hold and breathe slowly. Swap sides halfway.
mistakes: Arching your lower back.
Leaning your chest forward.
tips: Squeeze the glute of the back leg to feel more stretch.

voice.nameHowTo: Hip flexor stretch. Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front. Tuck your hips under and shift forward until you feel a stretch at the front of your back hip. Swap sides halfway.

moves.name: Spinal Twist
moves.intro: Lying on your back, you drop one knee across your body. It loosens your spine and lower back.
howTo: Lie on your back with your arms out wide.
Bring one knee across your body towards the floor.
Turn your head the other way.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold and breathe slowly. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Letting the opposite shoulder lift off the floor.
Pushing the knee down with your hand.
tips: Relax a little more on each breath out and let the knee sink by itself.

voice.nameHowTo: Spinal twist. Lie on your back with your arms out wide. Bring one knee across your body towards the floor and turn your head the other way. Keep both shoulders down and breathe.

moves.name: Cobra
moves.intro: Lying face down, you press your chest up. It stretches your abs and opens your spine.
howTo: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up gently to lift your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders down.
Hold, then lower slowly.
Hold and breathe slowly.
mistakes: Pushing up so high that your lower back pinches.
Shrugging your shoulders to your ears.
tips: Keep your elbows slightly bent and your neck long.

voice.nameHowTo: Cobra. Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders. Press up gently to lift your chest, keeping your hips on the floor and your shoulders down. Hold, then lower slowly.

moves.name: Deep Squat + Thoracic Rotation
moves.intro: In a deep squat, you reach one arm up and turn. It opens your hips and loosens your upper back.
howTo: Sink into a deep squat.
Put one hand on the floor.
Reach the other arm up to the ceiling, turning your chest.
Bring it down and switch sides.
Slow and smooth.
mistakes: Letting your heels lift.
Rushing the turn.
tips: Follow the reaching hand with your eyes.

voice.nameHowTo: Deep squat with thoracic rotation. Sink into a deep squat. Put one hand on the floor and reach the other arm up to the ceiling, turning your chest. Bring it down and switch sides.

moves.name: Pigeon Pose
moves.intro: You bring one knee forward and stretch the other leg back. It stretches your glutes and hips.
howTo: Start on all fours.
Bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Stretch the other leg back.
Lower your hips and fold forward if it feels good.
Hold and breathe slowly. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Letting your hips tip to one side.
Forcing the fold.
tips: Put a cushion under your hip if it doesn't reach the floor.

voice.nameHowTo: Pigeon pose. From all fours, bring one knee forward behind your wrist and stretch the other leg back. Lower your hips and fold forward over your front leg if it feels good. Breathe into the stretch.

moves.name: Seated Butterfly Stretch
moves.intro: Sitting with the soles of your feet together, you ease your knees down. It stretches your inner thighs.
howTo: Sit tall.
Put the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet and let your knees fall out.
Gently bounce your knees towards the floor.
Gentle and steady.
mistakes: Rounding your back.
Pushing your knees down with your hands.
tips: Move your feet further away to make it gentler.

voice.nameHowTo: Seated butterfly stretch. Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out. Hold your feet and gently bounce your knees towards the floor. Keep your back straight.

moves.name: Bodyweight Row
moves.intro: You hang under a low bar or rings and pull your chest up. It's the main pulling move you can do without a pull-up bar, working your upper back and biceps.
howTo: Lie under a low bar or rings and grip them with straight arms.
Keep your body in one straight line, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
One second up, two seconds down.
mistakes: Letting your hips sag as you pull.
Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears.
tips: Walk your feet back to make it easier, forward to make it harder.

voice.nameHowTo: Bodyweight row. Lie under a low bar or rings and grip with straight arms, body in one line. Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.

moves.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
moves.intro: A lunge with your back foot up on a bench. It loads your front leg heavily, so it builds strength and balance one side at a time.
howTo: Stand a stride in front of a bench, facing away from it.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about level with the floor.
Push through your front heel to come back up.
Two seconds down, one up. Swap legs halfway.
mistakes: Standing too close to the bench, so your front knee shoots forward.
Pushing off the back foot instead of the front leg.
tips: Lean your chest forward a little to work your glutes more.

voice.nameHowTo: Bulgarian split squats. Stand in front of a bench and rest one foot on it behind you. Lower into a lunge on your front leg, then push back up. Swap legs halfway.

moves.name: Calf Raises
moves.intro: You rise up onto your tiptoes and lower slowly. It strengthens your calves and ankles, which helps with running and jumping.
howTo: Stand tall, on the edge of a step if you have one.
Rise up onto your tiptoes as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly, below the step if you're on one.
One second up, a pause, three seconds down.
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom.
Rolling onto the outside edges of your feet.
tips: Hold a wall or rail lightly for balance, not for help.

voice.nameHowTo: Calf raises. Stand tall, on a step if you have one. Rise up onto your tiptoes as high as you can, pause, then lower your heels slowly.

moves.name: Chin Up
moves.intro: A pull-up with your palms facing you. It works your back and puts extra load on your biceps.
howTo: Hang from a bar with your palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower all the way down with control.
One second up, two or three seconds down.
mistakes: Swinging or kicking to get up.
Stopping short of a full hang at the bottom.
tips: Jump to the top and lower slowly if you can't pull up yet.

voice.nameHowTo: Chin up. Hang from a bar with your palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull up until your chin is over the bar, then lower all the way down with control.

moves.name: Dips
moves.intro: You lower and press your body between parallel bars or a sturdy edge. It works your triceps, chest and the fronts of your shoulders.
howTo: Support yourself on parallel bars or a sturdy edge with straight arms.
Lean forward a little and keep your shoulders down.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until they're at about a right angle.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Two seconds down, one up.
mistakes: Going so deep that your shoulders hurt.
Shrugging your shoulders up.
tips: Bend your knees and let your feet help if you can't do a full dip yet.

voice.nameHowTo: Dips. Support yourself on parallel bars or a sturdy edge with straight arms. Bend your elbows to lower your body, then press back up. Keep your shoulders down.

moves.name: Handstand Push Up
moves.intro: A push-up upside down against a wall. It's the hardest pushing move for your shoulders and arms.
howTo: Put your hands on the floor a hand's width from a wall.
Kick up into a handstand with your heels resting on the wall.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Slow and controlled. Only try it when pike push-ups feel strong.
mistakes: Letting your elbows flare straight out.
Dropping down too fast.
tips: Put a folded towel where your head lands.

voice.nameHowTo: Handstand push up. Kick up into a handstand against a wall. Bend your elbows to lower your head towards the floor, then press back up. Only try this when you're ready.

moves.name: Hanging Leg Raise
moves.intro: You hang from a bar and lift your legs. It works your abs and grip.
howTo: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Brace your stomach.
Lift your legs up in front of you.
Lower them slowly.
Slow and controlled, without swinging.
mistakes: Swinging to get your legs up.
Leaning back to cheat the lift.
tips: Bend your knees to make it easier.

voice.nameHowTo: Hanging leg raise. Hang from a bar with straight arms. Brace your stomach and lift your legs up in front of you, then lower them slowly without swinging.

moves.name: Pull Up
moves.intro: You hang from a bar and pull your chin over it. It's the main move for a strong back.
howTo: Hang from a bar with your palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
One second up, two or three seconds down.
mistakes: Swinging or kicking to get up.
Doing half reps that stop short of a full hang.
tips: Jump to the top and lower slowly if you can't pull up yet.

voice.nameHowTo: Pull up. Hang from a bar with your palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders. Pull up until your chin clears the bar, then lower slowly to a full hang.

moves.name: Quadruped Twister
moves.intro: On your hands and toes with your knees hovering, you swing both knees under you from side to side. It works your core and keeps your heart rate up.
howTo: Start on all fours, then lift your knees just off the floor.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Twist your hips so both knees swing under you to one side.
Come back through the middle and swing to the other side.
Quick and controlled.
mistakes: Letting your hips lift high.
Moving your shoulders with your hips.
tips: Keep your shoulders over your hands while your hips do the turning.

voice.nameHowTo: Quadruped twister. Start on all fours and lift your knees just off the floor. Twist your hips so both knees swing under you to one side, then back through the middle to the other side.

moves.name: Plank Punches with Leg Extension
moves.intro: In a high plank, you punch one arm forward and lift the opposite leg. It works your core, shoulders and glutes.
howTo: Hold a high plank.
Punch one arm forward and lift the opposite leg straight back at the same time.
Put them down.
Switch to the other arm and leg.
Controlled pace.
mistakes: Twisting your hips.
Lifting the leg so high that your back arches.
tips: Widen your feet to make it steadier.

voice.nameHowTo: Plank punches with leg extension. Hold a high plank. Punch one arm forward and lift the opposite leg straight back at the same time. Put them down and switch. Keep your hips level.

moves.name: Reverse Plank
moves.intro: A face-up plank on straight arms. It strengthens your glutes, back and shoulders and opens up your chest.
howTo: Sit with your legs straight and your hands on the floor behind you.
Point your fingers towards your feet.
Press through your hands and lift your hips into one straight line.
Hold, chest up and glutes squeezed.
Hold still and breathe steadily.
mistakes: Letting your hips drop.
Locking your elbows hard.
tips: Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.

voice.nameHowTo: Reverse plank. Sit with your legs out straight and your hands on the floor behind you. Press through your hands and raise your hips until you're in one straight line, chest up. Hold it there.

moves.name: Leg Swings Front to Back
moves.intro: Holding a wall, you swing one leg forward and back. It warms up your hips and hamstrings before a run.
howTo: Stand side-on to a wall or post and hold it.
Swing your outside leg forward.
Swing it back behind you.
Let each swing grow a little bigger.
Relaxed and rhythmic. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Leaning your body with the swing.
Forcing the leg too high.
tips: Keep your standing knee soft.

voice.nameHowTo: Leg swings, front to back. Stand side-on to a wall or post and hold it for balance. Swing your outside leg forwards and backwards like a pendulum, keeping it relaxed. Let each swing grow a little bigger.

moves.name: Leg Swings Side to Side
moves.intro: Facing a wall, you swing one leg across your body and out to the side. It warms up your hips and inner thighs.
howTo: Face a wall or post and hold it with both hands.
Swing one leg across the front of your body.
Swing it out to the side.
Let each swing grow a little bigger.
Relaxed and rhythmic. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Turning your hips with the swing.
Locking your standing knee.
tips: Keep your hips facing forward.

voice.nameHowTo: Leg swings, side to side. Face a wall or post and hold it with both hands. Swing one leg across the front of your body, then out to the side. Keep your hips facing forwards and your standing knee soft.

moves.name: Pogo Hops
moves.intro: Quick, springy bounces on the balls of your feet. It trains your calves and ankles to be stiff and springy for running.
howTo: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Bounce quickly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your knees almost straight and your heels just off the ground.
Keep each contact with the ground short.
Fast and springy, like the ground is hot.
mistakes: Bending your knees, so it turns into a squat jump.
Landing on your heels.
tips: Think about bouncing off the ground, not jumping high.

voice.nameHowTo: Pogo hops. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Bounce quickly on the balls of your feet, knees almost straight and heels just off the ground. Keep each contact short and springy, like the ground is hot.

moves.name: A-March
moves.intro: A slow, exaggerated march with high knees. It teaches the posture and knee drive for good running form.
howTo: Stand tall.
Drive one knee up to hip height as the opposite arm swings forward.
Put that foot down on its ball, right under your hips.
Switch legs and walk forwards.
Slow, sharp and precise.
mistakes: Leaning back.
Reaching the foot out in front.
tips: Keep your foot flexed, toes pulled up, as your knee comes up.

voice.nameHowTo: A-march. Walk forwards tall, driving one knee up to hip height as the opposite arm swings forward. Put each foot down on its ball, right under your hips. Slow, sharp and precise.

moves.name: A-Skips
moves.intro: A skip with high knees and quick feet. It builds on the A-march to train quick, light steps.
howTo: Stand tall.
Skip forwards, driving one knee up to hip height on each skip.
Swing the opposite arm forward.
Push the ground away under your hips.
Quick and light, not high.
mistakes: Leaning back.
Skipping for height instead of rhythm.
tips: Keep your foot flexed, toes pulled up.

voice.nameHowTo: A-skips. Skip forwards, driving one knee up to hip height on each skip as the opposite arm swings. Push the ground away under your hips and stay tall. Quick and light, not high.

moves.name: B-Skips
moves.intro: An A-skip with a kick out and a paw back. It trains your hamstrings to pull your foot back under you, as in running.
howTo: Skip forwards like an A-skip.
As your knee comes up, reach the lower leg out in front.
Sweep it down and back under you, pawing the ground.
Switch legs.
Stay tall and relaxed.
mistakes: Kicking the leg out high and stiff.
Landing in front of your body.
tips: Learn it slowly first: an A-march with a kick out.

voice.nameHowTo: B-skips. Skip forwards like an A-skip, but as your knee comes up, reach the lower leg out in front, then sweep it down and back under you, pawing the ground. Stay tall and relaxed.

moves.name: Carioca
moves.intro: You travel sideways, crossing your back leg in front and then behind. It loosens your hips and trains quick, light feet.
howTo: Stand side-on to the way you're going.
Cross your back leg in front of your lead leg.
Step out with your lead leg, then cross your back leg behind.
Keep repeating.
Quick and light. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Turning your shoulders with your hips.
Landing flat-footed.
tips: Let your hips turn while your shoulders stay facing forward.

voice.nameHowTo: Carioca. Travel sideways, crossing your back leg in front of your lead leg, then behind it, over and over. Let your hips turn while your shoulders stay facing forwards. Stay light on the balls of your feet.

moves.name: Straight-Leg Run
moves.intro: You run with almost straight legs, like scissors. It trains your hamstrings and glutes to pull your foot down under you.
howTo: Stand tall.
Run forwards with your legs almost straight.
Pull each foot down under your hips.
Land on the ball of the foot.
Quick steps.
mistakes: Leaning back.
Landing in front of your body.
tips: Pull the ground back under you with each step.

voice.nameHowTo: Straight-leg run. Run forwards with your legs almost straight, like scissors. Pull each foot down under your hips and land on the ball of the foot. Stay tall and keep the steps quick.

moves.name: Bounding
moves.intro: Long, springy strides with a moment of float. It builds power for running.
howTo: Stand tall.
Push hard off your back foot.
Drive your knee forward and up.
Float for a moment, then land and push off again.
Long and springy. Swing your arms big to match.
mistakes: Landing heavily on your heels.
Short, choppy strides.
tips: Think about going forward, not up.

voice.nameHowTo: Bounding. Run forwards with long, springy strides, driving your knee forward and up and pushing hard off the back foot. Float for a moment on each step and swing your arms big to match.

moves.name: Strides
moves.intro: Short, fast runs that build up to near your top speed. It trains good form at speed.
howTo: Start jogging.
Build up to about ninety percent of your top speed over the first few seconds.
Hold it smoothly.
Ease off before the end.
Fast but relaxed, not a sprint.
mistakes: Sprinting flat out.
Tensing your shoulders and face.
tips: Keep your shoulders loose and your hands relaxed.

voice.nameHowTo: Strides. Build up to about ninety percent of your top speed over the first few seconds, hold it smoothly, then ease off before the end. Fast but relaxed, not a sprint. Keep your shoulders loose.

moves.name: Standing Calf Stretch
moves.intro: With your hands on a wall, you lean in with one leg back. It stretches your calf.
howTo: Put your hands on a wall.
Step one foot back.
Keep that back leg straight and the heel down.
Lean in until you feel the stretch.
Hold and breathe slowly. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Letting your heel lift.
Bending the back knee.
tips: Point your back toes straight forward.

voice.nameHowTo: Standing calf stretch. Put your hands on a wall and step one foot back. Keep that back leg straight and the heel down, then lean in until you feel the stretch in your calf. Hold it there.

moves.name: Standing Quad Stretch
moves.intro: Standing, you pull one heel towards your glutes. It stretches the front of your thigh.
howTo: Stand tall, holding a wall if you need to.
Bend one knee and catch your foot behind you.
Draw your heel towards your glutes.
Keep your knees together and your hips pushed slightly forward.
Hold and breathe slowly. Stay on one side until the app switches.
mistakes: Arching your back.
Letting your knee drift out.
tips: Squeeze your glute to feel more stretch.

voice.nameHowTo: Standing quad stretch. Stand tall, holding a wall if you need to. Bend one knee and catch your foot behind you, drawing your heel towards your glutes. Keep your knees together and your hips pushed slightly forward.

moves.name: Bicep curls
moves.intro: You curl a pair of dumbbells up to your shoulders. It builds your biceps.
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl the weights up towards your shoulders.
Lower them slowly all the way down.
One second up, two seconds down.
mistakes: Swinging your body to lift the weight.
Letting your elbows drift forward.
tips: Pick a weight you can lift without swinging.

moves.name: Standing shoulder press
moves.intro: You press a pair of dumbbells overhead. It builds your shoulders and triceps.
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your stomach.
Press the weights straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
One second up, two seconds down.
mistakes: Arching your lower back to push the weight up.
Pressing the weights forward instead of straight up.
tips: Squeeze your glutes to keep your back straight.

moves.name: Kneeling row
moves.intro: With one knee and hand on a bench, you row a dumbbell up to your hip. It builds your upper back and biceps.
howTo: Put one knee and the same hand on a bench, back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand, arm straight down.
Pull the weight up towards your hip, elbow close to your side.
Lower it slowly.
One second up, two seconds down. Do one side, then the other.
mistakes: Twisting your body to lift the weight.
Rounding your back.
tips: Squeeze your shoulder blade back at the top.

moves.name: Lateral raises
moves.intro: You raise a pair of dumbbells out to the sides. It builds the sides of your shoulders.
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
Bend your elbows slightly.
Raise the weights out to the sides until your arms are level with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly.
One second up, two seconds down.
mistakes: Swinging your body to lift the weight.
Shrugging your shoulders up.
tips: Use a lighter weight than you think: it's a small muscle.
